metadata.name: Kimono AI
metadata.description: An assistant for the household that works with your files, safely.

configuration.label: Sandbox node
configuration.description: The address kimono node sandboxes enable printed, such as http://100.64.0.7:7480.

configuration.label: Kimono Git token
configuration.description: An access token with repository read and write.

configuration.label: Claude token
configuration.description: An Anthropic API key, or the token claude setup-token prints.

configuration.label: Composio API key
configuration.description: Optional. Lets it use people's own apps, such as Gmail or Calendar, once they connect them, and Pro Tools. A scoped key needs observability read access, or Pro Tools stay off.

configuration.label: Kimono Git address
configuration.description: Empty to use Kimono Git on this server.

configuration.label: Public links
configuration.description: Links to a chat or an artifact that open without signing in. Switched off, those links open only for people signed in to this Kimono.

configuration.label: Each person's share of the week
configuration.description: Percent of the weekly usage of the Claude plan behind the token. The owner isn't limited.

configuration.label: Each person's Pro Tools budget
configuration.description: US dollars a month each person may spend on Pro Tools: tools that need no account of theirs, such as voice, video, pictures and web search, charged to the Composio balance. People see it as credits, 100 to the dollar. 0 switches them off.

configuration.label: Each person's share of a 5-hour window
configuration.description: Percent of the plan's 5-hour window, on plans that have one. The owner isn't limited.

configuration.label: Tasks awake per person
configuration.description: Sandboxes one person can have running at once. Waking another puts their least recently used one to sleep.

configuration.label: Tasks awake on the server
configuration.description: Sandboxes running at once across everyone. Leave room for the rest of the house.

configuration.label: Memory per task (GB)
configuration.description: With no swap. An app that needs more is stopped.

configuration.label: Disk per task (GB)
configuration.description: Past it, the agent is told to free space; a little past it, work stops and the task's app is stopped.
